title: Talent and Payroll Data Pipeline Modernisation
raw_text: Nordvale Logistics Group currently extracts workforce data nightly from a legacy SQL Server estate into spreadsheets. We are replacing this with a governed ETL pipeline. The work covers building a Talend pipeline for applicant tracking system data, migrating existing SSIS packages, and exposing warehouse-ready tables. We need incremental loads, not full reloads, and a reconciliation report that identifies drift between the legacy extracts and the new pipeline. Failure of any source must not truncate a load.
requirements: Talend ETL pipeline over applicant tracking system data
SSIS package migration onto the new platform
Incremental load strategy with partial-failure tolerance
Reconciliation report detecting drift between legacy and new extracts
